name: Clean Cut
tagline: A raw recording goes in, the same video as a tight, fast-paced jump cut without pauses, fillers and retakes comes out.
description: The basic cleanup every recording needs, cut tight: dead air, "um"s and "uh"s, false starts and earlier takes are removed, every pause becomes a beat, and the last take of every line stays. Nothing gets added, and you also get a cut list to keep editing in Resolve, Premiere or Final Cut.
bring: A raw recording of you talking: to camera, over a screen recording, a talk or a podcast
Optional: how tight it should feel
get: The same video, shorter and clean, plus a cut list for your editor
steps: Find the pauses, fillers, false starts and repeated takes
Cut them out tight, keeping the last take of every line
Check every cut and export a cut list for your editor
Review it in FrameJam until it's right
